title: Philippine Senate Blue Ribbon Commission and 176 Yamashita treasure troves
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Philippine Senate Blue Ribbon Commission and 176 Yamashita treasure troves, about 1945; told c. 2000 at Manila, Philippines, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the Blue Ribbon Commission is charged with finding these 176 troves of treasure that have been buried in the Philippines by General Yakushima at the end of World War II.

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes a Blue Ribbon Commission of the Philippine Senate, an investigating committee in Manila, around the year 2000. Sheehan says it was charged with finding 176 hoards of treasure that a Japanese general, Yamashita, buried in the Philippines at the end of World War Two in 1945, and he mentions a Senator Pimentel and a Mr. Ayala. He tells it as part of a larger story about hidden wealth that powerful groups used in secret.
